Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 30-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE, MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Embedded programming [ECE_4450]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                   Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Suggest the design requirements in Embedded Systems and explain each of those.                       (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                      Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Discuss the importance of Compiling and Linking in Embedded Systems.                                 (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Elaborate the role of ROM Emulators in Embedded Systems.                                             (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Discuss the classification system of Memory in Embedded Systems with a brief note on Flash           (4)  
  memory characteristics.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Elaborate the selection criteria used in case of RTOS.                                               (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Discuss the different techniques used to measure the code efficiency.                                (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                With a neat schematic, explain the architecture of a Bus.                                            (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Elaborate on the importance of Interrupts used in an Embedded OS with relevant diagram.              (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Extend the significance of Built-in functions used in a Microprocessor.                              (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                Discuss the salient features of Round robin architecture without interrupts and its drawbacks.       (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  Page #1

B)                With a neat sketch, discuss the different task states used in RTOS.                                    (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Elaborate the execution flow in Semaphores by mentioning suitable example.                             (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        With a neat diagram, explain the process building software used in Embedded Systems.                   (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                             Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                What would be the poor plan for testing? Explain using a pseudocode.                                   (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)                Discuss the significance of Instruction set simulators.                                                (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
